market.what: Separated NdPr oxide, world (84% made in China)
market.method: 108 kt/yr NdPr oxide demand x $69/kg 2025 avg (USGS); spot ~$104/kg Oct 2026 (SMM)
market.job_what: NdPr solvent-extraction separation cost (extractant make-up + SX opex, or toll fee), world
market.job_method: 108 kt/yr NdPr oxide x ~$20/kg separation (est.; SX typically >$10/kg, China low end; Western toll $25-35/kg ReElement 2025) = ~$2.2B; low-med confidence

value.logic: La-Ce/Pr-Nd cut takes ~80 SX stages (SGS); 2x better Nd/La selectivity cuts that cut ~40%, ~13% of all stages, ~$1/kg TREO of $8/kg refining cost (Iluka). x est. 100 kt/yr ex-China separation by 2032 = $100M/yr
value.revenue_logic: 30% of ex-China capacity (30 kt TREO) x $0.40/kg licence + extractant supply
value.margin_logic: mostly licence (90%); extractant toll-made and resold at 50-60%

trend.drivers: EV, wind, robot motor magnets; China export controls Apr/Oct 2025; US $110/kg NdPr price floor (MP, 2025); western separation build-out
trend.deadline: DFARS 252.225-7052: no China-separated NdFeB in US defense items from 1 Jan 2027

competition.notes: Today's industrial best is P507/PC88A or Cyanex 572, not TODGA. Hardest split is Nd/Pr (beta ~1.4), Nd/La is easier. Phoenix Tailings $116.6M Series B (2025); Ucore RapidSX (not a startup) $27M DoD; Ames Lab NEAREST neutral ligands at mixer-settler scale.

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: phenanthroline-2,9-dicarboxamide core then amidation; 3 alkyl variants share the core
lab.test: Batch distribution ratios D and separation factors Nd/La, Nd/Pr vs P507 in HCl/HNO3 feed, ICP-OES at a university lab
lab.logic: synth 10 wk ~$30k (3 variants, China CRO) + test 4 wk: ~150 ICP-OES x $35-50 = ~$7k + feeds/reagents ~$3k

sale.gates: mini-pilot SX campaign (SGS/ANSTO/SRC, ~80 stages) ~1 yr; extractant loss and stability data; trial in a separator's circuit and oxide spec 1-2 yr; licence/supply deal
